structured.answer: From what I read, at my age (past retirement) I could take the money out tax-free after 3 years rather than 6. But I didn't come away with a clear amount: the page's example used a salary of 12,000 and a shares track with "S&P", and showed almost 30,000 ₪ going to tax at 5 years. So I'll ask you and the employer's clerk which track is safe and what I'd really get.

stuck.why: Chart says 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' while the text above said 3 years is enough for retirement age; I couldn't tell if the numbers apply to me
'הקרן מעבירה 29,768 ₪ למס הכנסה' then '15,794 ₪ מהם חוזרים' – back-and-forth tax numbers I couldn't follow; the big tax number scared me
Example is 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד S&P500' – shares, English letters; felt not for me

used: Opening text: 'אחרי 6 שנים... אפשר למשוך בלי מס', 'למי שהגיע לגיל הפרישה מספיקות 3 שנים'
'עד 4 ימי עסקים' to get the money
Fees table: 'עד 2% בשנה', actual 0.34%–0.74%, 'דמי יציאה: לא גובים'
skimmed: Who offers and who joins section
Long card about new deposits in another fund
skipped: Grey line '123 מקור 123 מחושב' under the title
Track buttons at top of calculator (S&P 500, מזומן שקלי)
'כמה העמלות האלה עולות לאורך זמן' link
unsure_meaning: Green/yellow/grey colours in the bar chart
not_found: A plain sentence: 'you will have about X ₪ after N years'
Whether the calculator takes my age (3-year rule) into account
A clearly marked safe/government-bond example amount

findings.what: Calculator ignores the 3-year rule for retirement age; shows tax before 6 years, which contradicts what I just read for someone like me
Big frightening tax figure (29,768 ₪) shown first, the refund explained after; confusing
Example is a shares track with English letters; a safe track example would suit people like me
findings.where: Screen 3, 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד S&P500'; screen 2 track buttons

findings.what: Black background with grey small text is hard on the eyes
findings.where: Whole page, especially grey lines and table headers
